needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this location to allow safe crossing when needed.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at this crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when using the signalised crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at this crossing to allow wheelchair users and others to access the footway safely.
Install street lighting along this urban road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers at night.
